statement.zh: 安阳殷墟在整个晚商始终是唯一都城，洹北等址不构成都城迁徙问题。
statement.en: Anyang Yinxu was always the sole Late Shang capital; Huanbei etc. raise no capital-shift issues.

disclaimer: Hypothesis: Huanbei and related Early Shang / Middle Shang capital debates remain active; do not collapse into a single settled narrative.
